items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: What about Didi? Didi? Didi, trumpet player. He played with John too?

ctx.x: He played in the brass band too. Both, huh?
Yeah, he played parades too with us. He played for the Budsets a couple of times. What about Didi? Didi? Didi, trumpet player. He played with John too?
Yeah, Didi used to be the leader.
